glyph.text: In the empty niche of the cracked wall, one glyph glows warmer than the runes round it, like an ember under ash.

opened.text: Stone grinds on stone. The cracked wall sinks into the floor, and cold air breathes out of a room nobody has opened in a thousand years.

open.text: The glyph has gone dark. Where the wall stood, the way into the hidden vault lies open.
